title_how: Powered land: lease megawatts, not just ground

flow.detail: Buy sites with existing or queued interconnection: retired plants, substation-adjacent land, utility surplus
Zoning, substation tie-in, cooling-ready pads, water rights, fiber laterals and perimeter security
Long-term ground and capacity leases per MW to data centers, BESS and EV fleet depots; tenants bring kit
Collect escalating rent, add tenants on spare MW and upsell fiber, security and power upgrades

payers.pays_for: Speed to power: energized MW and pads years ahead of the utility queue, on 15-20 yr leases
Ground lease per installed MW next to a substation, with a ready grid connection
Depot land with high-capacity charging connection near urban routes, leased per MW or slot
Rights of way, conduit and colocation on campus to serve the anchor tenants

title_market: Power, not land, is the new scarce permit

stats.label: Generation and storage capacity waiting in US interconnection queues at end-2024
Record-low vacancy in North American primary data center markets, H1 2026
Share of 7,481 MW of data center capacity under construction already preleased, H1 2026

unit_economics.note: Illustrative. Site cost anchored on MARA Texas deal (up to US$600M for 2 GW); rent, capex and margin are assumptions in line with ground leases.

precedents.name: Tract (US powered-land developer)
precedents.what: Assembles land, power, fiber and water, then sells or leases powered sites to hyperscalers; 25k+ acres and 25+ GW planned

precedents.name: MARA buys 2 GW Texas site (2026)
precedents.what: Acquired a 1,200-acre powered site with rights to up to 2 GW for up to US$600M (~US$0.3M/MW), partnering with Starwood

precedents.name: Homer City, Pennsylvania
precedents.what: Retired 1.9 GW coal plant reused as a 3,200-acre data center campus, keeping existing PJM and NYISO transmission ties

plan.milestones: Screen retired plants and substation land in TX and PJM; acquire 1-2 sites (100-300 MW); sign anchor tenant LOIs
Energize first campus; add BESS and fleet tenants on spare MW; 5-10 sites and 1 GW pipeline; JV with infra fund
Replicate in Brazil and Central America near grid nodes; platform of 2+ GW leased MW and recurring rent
